driveFolder.description: Root Drive folder holding footage/ and audio/ subtrees from the shoot.

prePipelineReleaseFolder.description: Path to the pre-prod release package: script.md, storyboard.json, concept-breakdown.xlsx, call-sheet-day-*.pdf, storyboard/v{n}/P*.png.

prePipelineReleaseHash.description: sha256 over the pre-prod release manifest, bound at intake.

audioLed.description: true when the cut follows the VO track (interview, doc); false when picture leads.

footageSource.description: shoot: camera rushes under driveFolder/footage. generated: one AI clip per storyboard panel, generated by the pipeline under driveFolder/footage/generated (a microdrama). hybrid: one actor plate per panel under driveFolder/footage/plates, the actor cut out and laid over a background for its location, composites under footage/composite. Absent means shoot.

generation.description: Only with footageSource generated: how each panel clip is made.

clipSec.description: Seconds of each panel USED in the cut when the panel names no length. Default 6.

headroomSec.description: Extra seconds asked of the model beyond what the cut uses, so the weak head and tail are trimmed and a line can breathe. Default 2; the request is capped at 15 s.

headSec.description: Where the used window starts inside the generated clip. Default 0.5.

generateAudio.description: Let the model generate ambience with the clip. Default false: the pipeline adds VO and music itself.

workspaceId.description: The 3echo workspace that pays for the clips.

hybrid.description: Only with footageSource hybrid: how the actor is cut out and laid over the background.

cutout.description: auto: OpenMontage decides per plate (chroma key on a clean green or blue screen, AI segmentation otherwise). Default auto.

similarity.description: Chroma key: how close to the screen colour is removed. Default 0.12.

match.description: How far the background brightness is moved towards the actor's. Default 0.5; 0 turns it off.

workspaceId.description: The 3echo workspace that pays for generated backgrounds.

referencesFolder.description: Optional: the reference library (characters/, wardrobe/, locations/, props/, motion/, labels.json). Absent means driveFolder/references. Read by scan-references.js at intake and by the generation brief.

referenceCutPath.description: Optional: path to a reference edit the sequencer should study for pacing.

colourDirection.description: LUT name, grade brief or 'client will grade' — human-declared at intake.
